# mcrl apm

[Command reference](README.md)

Show APM statistics.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`apm db`](#mcrl-apm-db) | Show database query statistics |
| [`apm http`](#mcrl-apm-http) | Show HTTP server statistics per route |

## mcrl apm db

Show database query statistics.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl apm db --service <service> [flags]

Show database query statistics, for at most the last 30 minutes of the range (the API's limit).
Sorted by --sort, descending unless --asc.

API: GET /api/v0/apm/db-query-stats
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl apm db --service web
  mcrl apm db --service web --since 10m --sort average --limit 5

Flags:
      --asc                ascending order
      --env string         deployment environment
      --limit int          maximum number of rows (0 = all) (default 20)
      --namespace string   service namespace
      --query string       SQL (partial match)
      --service string     service name (required)
      --since string       start of the time range (at most 30 minutes before --until) (default "30m")
      --sort string        sort column: average, executions, p95, sum (default "p95")
      --until string       end of the time range (default "now")
      --version string     service version
```

## mcrl apm http

Show HTTP server statistics per route.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl apm http --service <service> [flags]

Show HTTP server statistics per route, for at most the last 30 minutes of the range (the API's limit).
Sorted by --sort, descending unless --asc.

API: GET /api/v0/apm/http-server-stats
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl apm http --service web
  mcrl apm http --service web --since 10m --sort average --limit 5

Flags:
      --asc                ascending order
      --env string         deployment environment
      --limit int          maximum number of rows (0 = all) (default 20)
      --method string      HTTP method
      --namespace string   service namespace
      --route string       route (partial match)
      --service string     service name (required)
      --since string       start of the time range (at most 30 minutes before --until) (default "30m")
      --sort string        sort column: average, error-rate, p95, requests, sum (default "p95")
      --until string       end of the time range (default "now")
      --version string     service version
```
